thread.title: AAPL slides further as iPhone lens-maker reports big fall in sales, and analysts downgrade

author: Ben Lovejoy
title: AAPL slides further as iPhone lens-maker reports big fall in sales, and analysts downgrade
text: AAPL slides further as iPhone lens-maker reports big fall in sales, and analysts downgrade By Ben Lovejoy Dec 6, 2018, 10:00 am 74 pts AAPL stock is sliding further in early market trading, more than 3% down on yesterday’s close at the time of writing. It follows a 4.4% fall during yesterday’s trading. In the last 30 days, the stock has fallen from $209.95 on 7th November to around $171 now. The market is responding to two…
